title: Dexcom Time-in-Range Below Target
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dexcom:egv
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as samples, count(eval(glucose_value>=70 AND glucose_value<=180)) as in_range by person _time
| eval tir_pct=round(100*in_range/samples,1)
| where samples>0 AND tir_pct<70
| sort tir_pct
description: Uses Dexcom CGM readings telemetry to monitor daily time-in-range performance in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for days when glucose control slipped below target, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Dexcom CGM readings data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It flags daily time-in-range performance so you can spot days when glucose control slipped below target before it becomes annoying.
